ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black pixel ratio, approximately 80% high-intensity (white) surface area with 20% low-intensity (black) boundary and interior marking distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous white lobes bisected by low-intensity vertical notch zone; continuous high-contrast black banding along leading and trailing edges; irregular dark focal cluster at approximately [X:20%, Y:60%] on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression; approximate 45-degree interior angle; depth relative to lobe height approximately 0.15:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, moderate-frequency serrations visible on the distal third of both trailing edges; proximal edges near notch appear relatively smooth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex sweep along leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a slight sigmoidal curve transitioning from concave near the notch to convex near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters concentrated around the median notch and the interior margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear streaks; prominent grouping of diagonal parallel lines (rake marks) on the mid-to-distal right lobe; isolated horizontal streak on mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rake mark scarring on the right lobe; irregular dark mottling and pigmentation loss around the central notch axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, isolated dark circular spot located on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe's ventral surface.
